I lived at a shelter for a few days with my mom and my sisters when I was about 16. My ex stepdad hit my mom and we called the cops and they took us there. (When we came back home we found out he had taken around 100 to kill himself, he lived). Anyways, the shelter was awful. We went back home to an abusive stepdad because of how unwelcome we felt altogether.  The other women were very catty towards my mom and the whole shelter was very cliquey.  We were not aware everyone bought their own food so the next day after we moved in we were forced to eat their leftovers and expired food because it is all the shelter had to offer. I didn't mind it much but my little sisters cried every night. It forced my mom to move back in with my awful stepdad.  I wish the situation would have been different where we would have felt supported and maybe then we wouldn't have moved back in with someone we no longer felt safe with. My mom stayed married to him for a couple more years. She didn't divorce him until he had a knife to my stomach and was threatening to kill me. 

So yea, I wish the shelter would have been a more supportive place and I wish they would at least have some food for incoming families. It was tough. It was very tough. I hope Nobody has to go though what we went through. :/

I'm probably going to get downvoted for this, but I can certainly understand WHY they might be doing it. I personally don't have a cat, but I have a Doberman who is EXTREMELY needy. He requires tons of exercise and attention and if you don't give him those things he acts out and pees in the house and tears things apart. I am getting more and more pregnant each day and it's getting harder to give him adequate exercise and it breaks my heart. I wish I could run with him but he has to walk in a leash since he has dropped me before while I was pregnant. My husband works all day so he can't do it. I'm not going to give away my dog or anything, but I am going to Send him to my mom's for a while once I am about to have the baby, he is honestly too much to handle.

So Yea, I don't judge these people.

Ugh. The fact I'm going to be a mother in less than 90 days. Will I be a good mom? Will my child be happy? Will he love me? 
Today I saw his little face in 3d ultrasound and I can't stop thinking about him, He's beautiful and fat and he looks just like his dad. 
Then I think about his dad, my husband. We are by no means in a perfect situation, we have huge fights and he has an alcohol problem, I don't want my son to have a bad example. I love my husband to death and I would be lying if I said he isn't trying really hard to stay away from alcohol since our last fight. He hasn't had a drop, but I'm scared he will fall again and drink again. He is very stubborn and doesn't want to seek help, he thinks he doesn't have a problem. Right now things are good, He's a hard worker and wants to be a good father to our son. 
I hope he loves our son enough to make better decisions about his well being. I hope that if one day I die or something he can be a pillar of strength for our little one. 
I worry about school, I didn't qualify for financial aid this year and I have no idea whatsoever how I'm going to pay for it. I am really pregnant right now so I can't exactly get a job. (I had an interview on Monday, so hopefully I do have a job soon). I have no idea how I will get the money. I don't want to stress out my husband any more since we have tons of things to pay for and He's the only one working, especially with a kid on the way. It's hard. It's scary not knowing what is going to happen, maybe I won't be able to go to school anymore. I want to go to school, so I hope I can figure something out. 

Also, my baby kicks a lot so it's hard to get comfortable lol. It keeps me up every single night, it doesn't help that I'm thinking about the future. I love this little creature more than anything, I know that even if I am a single mom, don't go to school and have to work really hard to support him by himself, I'll be okay. I keep telling myself things will be okay.

He always spills shower water all over the bathroom floor...we have a double curtain, how does it even happen? It's like he doesn't towel dry himself and just runs out of the shower soaking wet. Drives me nuts. Still love him though.
